name: support-journal-only-finalization-recovery
title: Support journal-only finalization recovery
description: Allow fail-closed planning finalization when valid planning commits were already published before the journal-only finish-work successor was created.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Observed after commits d97244e and 9c9b8c3 were already on main: finish-work created journal commit 686f484, but the captured 9c9b8c3..686f484 range failed with planning_task_change_missing. Preserve that journal commit unchanged and unpushed until the corrected validator proves the exact range.
